# venues.json reference

`paperpush/venues.json` is the **master list** of venues: a venue exists exactly
when it has an entry here. Each entry records the venue's general metadata.
What paperpush can do with a venue comes from the two companion databases: a
venue with an entry in `submission_forms.json` (and a runner) can be submitted
to, and a venue with an entry in `manuscript_requirements.json` has author
guidelines that `validate` measures the manuscript against. A venue may have
either or both. The top-level object maps a venue slug (`biorxiv`, `nature`,
...) to its entry. This page is generated from `paperpush/venues.schema.json`,
which is itself generated from the `VenueInfo` dataclass in
`paperpush/database.py` -- that is the source of truth.

## Venue entry

The keys of one venue entry (the value under a slug).

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | Display name. Defaults to the slug when omitted. |
| `full_name` | string | Full, unabbreviated venue name. |
| `venue_type` | `preprint` \| `journal` \| `conference` | Kind of venue: a preprint server, a journal, or a conference. |
| `anonymous` | boolean | Anonymous (double-blind) review: validate checks the attached files and linked anonymous.4open.science repositories for information identifying the authors. |
| `deprecated` | boolean | Hidden from listings but still reachable by get_venue. |
| `site_url` | string | Public homepage URL. |
| `submission_guide` | string | URL of the author/submission guide. |
| `description` | string | Short description of the venue. |
